fields.name: name
fields.description: The primary key of this schema, representing the raw data for a single specimen.

fields.name: studyId
fields.description: Id of study.

fields.name: targetCaptureKitID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the kit used to construct a genomic library using target capture-based techniques, which should be composed of the vendor name, kit name and kit version.

fields.name: aliquotID
fields.description: A unique identifier (non-PII) that represents the aliquots used for e.g. replicate runs. This is linked to the specimenID.

fields.name: specimenID
fields.description: A unique identifier (non-PII) that represents the subspecimen (subsample) from which the data came,  e.g. an ID that distinguishes between different parts of the same parent tumor specimen.

fields.name: individualID
fields.description: A unique identifier (non-PII) that represents the individual from which the data came. This could be a patient or animal ID.

fields.name: parentSpecimenID
fields.description: A unique identifier (non-PII) that represents the parent specimen (sample) from which the data came from, e.g. the single parent tumor that was subsectioned into several samples.  The parentSpecimenID can be the same as specimenID when there is no subsectioning.

fields.name: transplantationType
fields.description: Type of transplantation involved in the experiment, derived from MESH

fields.name: compoundDoseUnit
fields.description: A unit associated with the value(s) in compoundDose.

fields.name: isStranded
fields.description: Whether or not the library is stranded (Yes; No)

fields.name: readPairOrientation
fields.description: The relative orientation of the reads in a paired-end protocol

fields.name: accessType
fields.description: Indicates access type / possible procedures needed for access to the resource.

fields.name: nf1Genotype
fields.description: Genotype of NF1 gene in the biospecimen from which the data were derived, if known.

fields.name: diagnosis
fields.description: Diagnosis for the individual given signs and symptoms. Use the most specific diagnosis term that applies.

fields.name: targetDepth
fields.description: The targeted read depth prior to sequencing.

fields.name: age
fields.description: A numeric value representing age of the individual. Use with `ageUnit`.

fields.name: ageUnit
fields.description: A time unit that can be used with a given age value, e.g. years.

fields.name: isCellLine
fields.description: Whether or not sample source is a cell line (Yes; No)

fields.name: libraryPreparationMethod
fields.description: Method by which library was prepared

fields.name: averageBaseQuality
fields.description: Average base quality collected from samtools

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Phenotypic expression of chromosomal makeup that defines a study subject as male, female, or other.

fields.name: genePerturbationType
fields.description: Specific way in which a single gene was perturbed in a sample

fields.name: compoundDose
fields.description: A dose quantity for the treatment compound. To be used with compoundDoseUnit.

fields.name: readDepth
fields.description: If available, the coverage statistic as output from bedtools coverage or samtools stats.

fields.name: readLength
fields.description: Number of base pairs (bp) sequenced for a read

fields.name: readStrandOrigin
fields.description: The strand from which the read originates in a strand-specific protocol

fields.name: progressReportNumber
fields.description: if submitting data for the 6-month milestone report for NTAP, progressReportNumber=1.  Also if submitting data associated with first milestone, progressReportNumber =1

fields.name: specimenPreparationMethod
fields.description: Term that represents preservation of the sample before usage in, e.g. sequencing

fields.name: isMultiIndividual
fields.description: Whether or not a file has data for multiple individuals (Yes; No)

fields.name: libraryStrand
fields.description: Strandedness of paired-end RNA-Sequencing data. This is an important parameter for RNA-seq analysis.

fields.name: readPair
fields.description: The read of origin, Read 1 or Read 2

fields.name: initiative
fields.description: Refers to a funding initiative. Typically handled by the DCC.

fields.name: genePerturbationTechnology
fields.description: Technology used to perturb gene

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Brief free-text comments that may also be important to understanding the resource.

fields.name: fileFormat
fields.description: Defined format of the data file, typically corresponding to extension, but sometimes indicating more general group of files produced by the same tool or software

fields.name: nf2Genotype
fields.description: Genotype of NF2 gene in the biospecimen from which the data were derived, if known

fields.name: Component
fields.description: Type of metadata template; provide the same one for all items/rows.

fields.name: species
fields.description: The name of a species (typically a taxonomic group) of organism.

fields.name: fundingAgency
fields.description: Refers to the funding organization for the generated resource. This annotation is handled by the DCC.

fields.name: nucleicAcidSource
fields.description: Source of the extracted nucleic acid used in the experiment

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Color channel used to generate data file.

fields.name: genePerturbed
fields.description: The HUGO gene symbol for the gene that is perturbed.

fields.name: resourceType
fields.description: The type of resource being stored and annotated

fields.name: dissociationMethod
fields.description: Procedure by which a biological specimen is dissociated into individual cells or a cell suspension

fields.name: readsDuplicatedPercent
fields.description: Percent of duplicated reads collected from samtools

fields.name: isMultiSpecimen
fields.description: Whether or not a file has data for multiple specimens (Yes; No)

fields.name: studyName
fields.description: Name of a study.

fields.name: isPrimaryCell
fields.description: Whether or not cellType is primary (Yes; No)

fields.name: workflow
fields.description: Name and version of the workflow used to generate/analyze the data

fields.name: workflowLink
fields.description: Workflow URL reference

fields.name: pairsOnDifferentChr
fields.description: Pairs on different chromosomes collected from samtools

fields.name: transplantationRecipientTissue
fields.description: Tissue into which a xenograph sample is transplanted

fields.name: individualIdSource
fields.description: Database or repository to which individual ID maps

fields.name: totalReads
fields.description: If available, the total number of reads collected from samtools.

fields.name: dataType
fields.description: Links an entity to data types that the entity represents/contains. This is closely tied to the assay property. For example, a file of dataType `genomicVariants` might have an assay value of `whole genome sequencing`.

fields.name: dataSubtype
fields.description: Further qualification of dataType, which may be used to indicate the state of processing of the data, aggregation of the data, or presence of metadata.

fields.name: genomicReference
fields.description: Version of genome reference used for alignment in processing workflow

fields.name: organ
fields.description: A unique macroscopic (gross) anatomic structure that performs specific functions. It is composed of various tissues. An organ is part of an anatomic system or a body region.

fields.name: isXenograft
fields.description: Whether or not sample source is a xenograft (Yes; No)

fields.name: drugScreenType
fields.description: String describing general class of drug screen

fields.name: experimentalCondition
fields.description: A free-text description of the experimental condition (e.g. 5 mM doxorubicin).

fields.name: modelSystemName
fields.description: HEK293 (cell line), Minnesota5 (swine strain), DXL (poultry strain), RB51 (vaccine strain of Brucella abortus)

fields.name: libraryPrep
fields.description: The general strategy by which the library was prepared

fields.name: tumorType
fields.description: The type of tumor that the biospecimen used to generate the data were collected from.

fields.name: expressionUnit
fields.description: Measure used for transcript expression quantification

fields.name: readsMappedPercent
fields.description: Percent of mapped reads collected from samtools

fields.name: averageInsertSize
fields.description: Average insert size as reported by samtools

fields.name: compoundName
fields.description: //pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/10127622)

fields.name: runType
fields.description: Sequencing run type.

fields.name: transplantationRecipientSpecies
fields.description: Species into which donor  was grown

fields.name: cellType
fields.description: A cell type is a distinct morphological or functional form of cell.

fields.name: modifiedBy
fields.description: Refers to a user who last modified the resource on the platform.

fields.name: experimentalTimepoint
fields.description: The numeric value indicating the time elapsed from the beginning of the experiment at which the specimen was collected. Use in tandem with timePointUnit

fields.name: assay
fields.description: The technology used to generate the data in this file.

fields.name: averageReadLength
fields.description: Average read length collected from samtools

fields.name: platform
fields.description: A sequencing platform, microscope, spectroscope/plate reader, or other platform for collecting data.
